Speaker: Moss Mulligan, the Corrupted Druid
Effective line: The Rot took Archdruid Compostella first, at the Rotheart, deep in the Verdant Dump. Everything else grew out from her.
Suggested line: The Rot took Archdruid Compostella first, at the Rotheart, deep in the Verdant Dump. Everything grew out from her. Me too, the day a very tidy lady with shears came calling.
Why: Plants Clipwell (who corrupted Moss) before the mill, in Moss's shy voice.

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: You eat roast roots and a pie with a crust like a fence post. The mug is mostly apple. You are thoroughly farm-fed. HP restored.
Suggested line: You eat roast roots and a pie with a crust like a fence post. The mug is mostly apple. A goat watches every bite. HP restored.
Why: Replaces a flat third beat with the zone's goat gag; works before and after freeing.

Speaker: Dump workers
Effective line: New stairs. Same climb. I was hoping they would fix that.
Suggested line: New stairs. Same climb. And the stairs grew two more steps overnight.
Why: Puts the never-stops-growing wrongness into a worker grumble; keeps the freed pair's opening.

Speaker: Dump workers
Effective line: Every terrace a little higher, every terrace a little weirder. That's the Dump for you.
Suggested line: The Buffet calls us garbage eaters. Half our garbage is their souffle, barely touched.
Why: Seeds the Gourmand rivalry from inside the zone; the old line was filler.

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: The belt has never lost a piece of sleep over your performance.
Suggested line: The belt does not slow down for anyone. It has been asked.
Why: The old idiom was garbled; this is cleaner and lands on a joke.

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: A pile of tyres, doors and ambition across the gap.
Suggested line: A pile of tyres, doors and one very stubborn wardrobe across the gap.
Why: "Ambition" is the third junk-pile ambition in the zone; a concrete object is funnier.

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: A trash golem towers over you, moss coating its fridge body. Something sprouts from its ears. This is no place for a cool head.
Suggested line: A trash golem towers over you, moss coating its fridge body. Something sprouts from its ears. Inside, the little light is still on.
Why: "Cool head" is the Buffet golems' owned pun; the fridge-light image is the Dump's own joke.

Speaker: Brother Bramble
Effective line: We are the Refusemancers: druids of waste removal and agriculture. Our animals eat the kingdom's garbage and turn it into fertilizer, and our magic helps the crops grow.
Suggested line: We are the Refusemancers: druids of waste removal and agriculture. Our animals turn the kingdom's garbage into fertilizer for its crops. The Buffet calls us garbage eaters. They eat our carrots.
Why: Same facts, shorter, plus the rivalry and why the Paths need each other, punchline last.

Speaker: Granny Gristle
Effective line: Shop's open, dearie! Turnips are a day old. A lovely vintage, if you're a turnip.
Suggested line: Back again, dearie! Turnips are a day old. A lovely vintage, if you're a turnip.
Why: Retires the generic "Shop's open" greeting; keeps the vintage turnip gag.

Speaker: Wren Muckfoot
Effective line: The boar and goat in the stables will carry you. Ask nicely. Ask rudely. They don't speak either. Good, sensible animals.
Suggested line: The boar and goat in the stables will carry you. Ask nicely or ask rudely; they ignore both the same. Good, sensible animals.
Why: "They don't speak either" reads as a contradiction right after "I speak fluent goat".

Zone/Area: Verdant Dump / The Trash Panda Throne
Speaker: His Majesty the Raccoon
Effective line: 'WE DID NOT EAT THE COMPOST. We sampled it.' His Majesty grips the throne. 'The royal tasting is not open to questions.'
Suggested line: 'WE DID NOT EAT THE COMPOST. We... sampled it.' His Majesty grips the throne. 'The royal tasting is not open to questions.'
Why: Restores the canon catchphrase's pause ("We... sampled it").

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: Normal-looking plants, mostly. They are a little too green. Everything is alive in a way that feels like it is watching you.
Suggested line: Normal-looking plants, mostly. A little too green. Every leaf turns, very slightly, to follow you.
Why: Shows the watching instead of telling the player how it feels.

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: The vines are choosing who gets through. Can your deck keep its footing?
Suggested line: The vines are choosing who gets through. They are reading your deck very closely.
Why: "Footing" is Coach Benchley's owned pun.

Speaker: Hortensia Clipwell, Royal Groundskeeper
Effective line: Such a pretty weed. Such a shame. Now, stand still while I tidy you.
Suggested line: Gentlemen, if you would. He is well over regulation height.
Why: Was a word-for-word repeat of her intro line; now she sends the topiaries in with her regulation-height tic.

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: It tastes of rain and regret. You feel hardier, and a little poisoned.
Suggested line: It tastes of rain and old boots. You feel hardier, and a little poisoned.
Why: "Rain and regret" repeats the mushroom result; the boot calls back the pool's own text.

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: A tunnel full of drifting spores. Whether you can walk through it depends on how well your deck has been built.
Suggested line: A tunnel of drifting spores. A well-built deck walks straight through. A loose one starts to sprout.
Why: Same hint, with a turn at the end instead of a rules sentence.

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: You see light pour through the splitting Rotheart.
Suggested line: Light pours through the splitting Rotheart.
Why: Drops the flat "You see" camera narration the review flagged.

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: You watch wildflowers follow the light outward through the Dump.
Suggested line: Wildflowers follow the light outward, field by field, through the Dump.
Why: Drops "You watch"; one concrete image.

Speaker: Granny Gristle
Effective line: Shop's open! Day-old turnips. None looking at anybody. Finally, produce that knows when to look away. Heh!
Suggested line: Day-old turnips, dearie, and not one of them looking at anybody. Finally, produce with manners. Heh!
Why: Retires "Shop's open" and tightens the turnip payoff.

Speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
Effective line: Archdruid Compostella. I am told what happened to the barn. I cannot remember doing it. I will help put it right.
Suggested line: Archdruid Compostella. I am told what happened to the barn. I cannot remember doing it. The barn, I gather, remembers me. I will help put it right.
Why: Lands her canon barn gag (she forgets, it remembers); her bark already offers to mend it.
